text.en:
Whenever the public interests so require, the provincial board may, with the approval of the
Department Head, transfer any amount from the existing balances of the different provincial funds to another
fund in order to cover deficiencies in the latter.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Enacted, without Executive approval, November 30, 1936.
